pages.text: $(italic)Modular armor in the Tetra style.$()$(br2)Iridescent Reforging brings Tetra's module-and-honing framework to the armor slot. A reforged piece has slots for major and minor modules, a stat-bearing primary attribute pool, and a 5-level honing track per slot.$(br2)Two paths to obtain: $(thing)craft$() a blank reforged piece from leather, or $(thing)convert$() a specialized armor (Cultist, Pyromancer, etc.) and carry its identity through.

pages.title: How to reforge
pages.text: $(bold)Drop in the Tetra workbench.$()$(br2)Whether you're starting with vanilla iron armor or a specialized piece (Cultist Hood, Phoenix Robes, Aquaculture Diving Helmet, etc.), placing it in the Tetra workbench's input slot replaces it with a Reforged variant ready for module work.$(br2)$(bold)Specialized armor keeps its identity:$() the source's school spell power, set bonus, Apotheosis affixes, and enchantments all carry through. Visual model preserved (ISS via Geckolib; others via the source mod's vanilla armor texture).$(br2)$(bold)Generic vanilla armor$() gets the modular shape with a default-tier module installed (iron variant) — upgrade at the workbench.

pages.title: Module slots
pages.text: Each reforged piece has 2 slots:$(br2)$(thing)Helmet$() — crown (major) + visor (minor)$(br)$(thing)Chestplate$() — chest_plate (major) + chest_lining (minor)$(br)$(thing)Leggings$() — leg_plate (major) + belt (minor)$(br)$(thing)Boots$() — boot_sole (major) + boot_lining (minor)$(br2)Major slots take metal materials and provide armor bonuses. Minor slots take fabric/leather/fibre OR themed materials and provide utility (mana regen, KB resist, speed, school spell power, etc.).

pages.title: Themed module materials
pages.text: Minor slots accept themed materials that give axis-flavored bonuses:$(br2)$(thing)Fire$() — blaze rod ($(item)+fire spell power$())$(br)$(thing)Ice$() — blue ice ($(item)+ice spell power$())$(br)$(thing)Shadow$() — ghast tear ($(item)+blood spell power$())$(br)$(thing)Holy$() — glowstone dust ($(item)+holy spell power$())$(br)$(thing)Lightning$() — redstone ($(item)+lightning spell power$())$(br)$(thing)Nature$() — sapling ($(item)+mana regen$())$(br)$(thing)Ender$() — ender pearl ($(item)+ender spell power$())$(br)$(thing)Blood$() — rotten flesh ($(item)+blood spell power$())$(br2)Mix-and-match: a Cultist Hood with a $(thing)Shadow visor$() doubles up on blood magic; a Phoenix Robe with a $(thing)Fire lining$() pushes fire bonus higher.

pages.title: Honing
pages.text: Each slot has a 5-level honing track scaling its signature stat:$(br2)$(thing)Helmet$() — armor toughness (+0.5 to +3.0)$(br)$(thing)Chestplate$() — armor (+0.5 to +3.0)$(br)$(thing)Leggings$() — knockback resistance (+0.02 to +0.10)$(br)$(thing)Boots$() — movement speed (+0.001 to +0.005)$(br2)Hone with the same hammer tiers as spellbooks: gold (L1), iron (L2), steel (L3), diamond (L4), netherite (L5).$(br2)At L3 you can apply the $(bold)settled$() schematic to lock the slot's identity and gain a small cross-stat bonus.

pages.title: Specialized skin coverage
pages.text: $(bold)v0.2 covers 42+ sets$() across ISS, Aether, Twilight Forest, Cataclysm, Aquaculture, Forbidden Arcanus, Undergarden, Deeperdarker, Botania, Blue Skies, Deep Aether.$(br2)Each set's signature attributes — armor, toughness, magic damage, school-specific spell power — carry through to the reforged version. The Geckolib visual model is preserved for ISS armors; vanilla armor textures route through the source mod's existing texture path for non-Geckolib sets.$(br2)Theabyss elemental sets, Aethersteel, and Alex's Mobs single-slot specialty pieces land in v0.2.x.

pages.title: Set bonuses
pages.text: $(bold)Set bonuses persist through reforging.$()$(br2)When you wear 4 reforged pieces all sharing the same set identity (e.g. 4 reforged Phoenix pieces), the original full-set bonus fires automatically.$(br2)Examples:$(br)$(thing)Phoenix$() — fire immunity$(br)$(thing)Neptune$() — water breathing + dolphin's grace$(br)$(thing)Aquaculture Neptunium$() — water breathing$(br)$(thing)Yeti$() — strength$(br)$(thing)Gravitite$() — jump boost II$(br)$(thing)Ignitium / Fiery$() — fire immunity$(br2)Mixed sets (Phoenix helmet + Cultist chestplate + ...) lose set bonuses — the per-piece base attributes still apply.
